info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Meetings Meetings Participants-v1-spec
info.description: The Meetings Participants Retrieval API facilitates access to the list of participants associated with specific meetings. This endpoint allows users to obtain detailed information about the individuals attending each meeting, enhancing the ability to manage and coordinate schedules. Typical consumers of this API include event organizers, administrative staff, and applications that rely on meeting data for analytics or reporting. By effectively utilizing this API, organizations can ensure better engagement and communication among participants.

get.summary: Retrieve the list of participants in a meeting.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all participants associated with a specific meeting. It provides detailed information about each participant, including their roles and statuses within the meeting.
